t: A low-cost open smartwatch you can wear, tweak and reprogram.
steps: Buy the sealed watch from the Pine64 store. Pick the dev kit for low-level work.
Charge the watch on its clip-on dock with any USB port.
Install Gadgetbridge on Android, or Amazfish or Siglo on Linux.
Pair the watch with the app over Bluetooth.
Update InfiniTime to the latest release over the air from the app.
Try the step counter and the heart rate app as a first test.
Read the InfiniTime build guide to change a watch face.
Get a debug probe for the dev kit before you try other firmware.
